Only apps/api/src/modules/analytics/index.ts (new module) plus rule tests test/spec/analytics/record-events/**. recordEvents(db, {appId, userId|null, deviceId|null, events, clock}): one transaction; per event INSERT INTO app.event_dedup ... ON CONFLICT (event_type, event_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING, and only a newly acquired key writes app.events (name = event_type = eventType; props JSON-serialised, the 0140 object CHECK rejects non-objects; user_id / device_id only from the caller; client_at passed through; server_at = clock.now() once per call); returns {accepted, duplicates}; any error rolls the whole batch back; no validation (the receiver validates). detachUserEvents(db, {appId, userId}): UPDATE app.events SET user_id = NULL WHERE app_id AND user_id, returns the affected count (D10-1489 default, pending owner confirmation; wiring into account deletion belongs to identity, not here). Rule tests (Codex, 1 attempt): originally 18 tests (red/1 18/18 PASS, implementation red/2 18/18). reviews.note: Codex via codex-run.sh, couli-runs/CT-13g/review-codex-money-r1.json: pass with two S2 — (1) two concurrent batches [A,B] / [B,A] can deadlock (40P01) and one call fails (rolled back, no duplicates; availability only); (2) the dedup key (event_type, event_id) has no app_id (CT-13e design, merged), so app B reusing app A's UUID gets duplicates=1.
